tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many Deepnia credits they have left, or before proposing a creation they may not be able to afford: returns the credits available on their account. The price of one creation comes from quote_image, quote_video or quote_voiceover.

tools.name: list_creation_options
tools.description: Use this when you need the choices for a creation before pricing it: the models, durations, formats and modes for an image, a short video or a voice-over, and the pictures each model takes (max_reference_images, start_image, end_image). For voice-overs: the voices of one model, filtered by language

tools.name: quote_image
tools.description: Use this when the user wants Deepnia to make an image: gets its exact price in Deepnia credits before anything is created. Nothing is charged. Reference images keep the exact product/person: give the product photo here. Show the price to the user; once they accept, call create_image with the quote_i

tools.name: quote_video
tools.description: Use this when the user wants Deepnia to make a short video: gets its exact price in Deepnia credits before anything is created. Nothing is charged. Reference images keep the exact product/person: give the product photo here. Show the price to the user; once they accept, call create_video with the qu

tools.name: quote_voiceover
tools.description: Use this when the user wants Deepnia to make a voice-over reading the given text with a chosen voice: gets its exact price in Deepnia credits before anything is created. Nothing is charged. Show the price to the user; once they accept, call create_voiceover with the quote_id and credits it returns:

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Use this when the user accepted the price from quote_image: makes the image with Deepnia from that quote_id and credits, paid with the user's Deepnia credits and saved in their Deepnia account. Refunded if it fails; the same quote_id never charges twice. Then follow it with get_creation.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Use this when the user accepted the price from quote_video: makes the video with Deepnia from that quote_id and credits, paid with the user's Deepnia credits and saved in their Deepnia account. Refunded if it fails; the same quote_id never charges twice. Then follow it with get_creation.

tools.name: create_voiceover
tools.description: Use this when the user accepted the price from quote_voiceover: makes the voice-over with Deepnia from that quote_id and credits, paid with the user's Deepnia credits and saved in their Deepnia account. Refunded if it fails; the same quote_id never charges twice. Then follow it with get_creation.

tools.name: get_creation
tools.description: Use this when a creation was started and the user wants its result: returns the state of one creation (queued, processing, completed, failed, refunded) and, once completed, its file links. Call it after create_* with the returned id, again after check_again_in_seconds while it is not finished, then

tools.name: list_my_creations
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what they already made through this app, or an earlier creation's id or link is needed: lists the images, videos and voice-overs this app created on their Deepnia account, newest first, with their state and file links. To follow a creation just started, call get_creation.
